release_notes:
## Nesting and export steps, restructured
- Both phases now have the same shape: the things you set are in their own strip ABOVE the numbered steps (BEFORE YOU NEST, VERSIONS), and the step row holds only steps, with the secondary actions grouped together on the right
- "Reset Nest" was three different operations fused into one button — it cleared this reel's progress AND untracked every reel AND threw away the timeline scan, so wanting any one of them cost you the other two, and the forced rescan felt like a punishment for clicking reset. It is now three buttons named for what they actually do:
    - Reset status — this reel's episodes back to pending. Timelines stay scanned
    - Clear — untracks every reel this session. Timelines stay scanned
    - Rescan — discards the scanned track/tails data and re-reads Premiere. The only one that loses work, so the only one that asks first
- Same words Adobe Media Encoder uses for its own queue, since that is where this workflow continues anyway
- "Skip Nest" is now "Skip to export" and sits with the other secondary actions — it used to sit at the far right of PHASE 1 while actually jumping you to PHASE 2. Its toggled state reads "Back to nesting"
- PHASE 2 mirrors all of it: "Reset Queue" is now "Clear queue", and "Rescan episodes" is its own button. "Connect to AME" no longer relabels ITSELF into a rescan button, so step 1 always says what it is

## Right-click an episode chip
- Reset that one episode to pending, reset from it onward, or reset the whole reel. Renesting one bad episode no longer costs you the other nineteen — the same way Resolve lets you clear render status on a single job

## Fixes
- The thinking dots no longer keep spinning after a nest finishes. A fresh Nest Episodes click started the animation twice but stopped it once, so it could never settle. Resuming a stopped nest was unaffected, which is why it only showed on a fresh run
- Removed the per-track mute logging added in 1.0.8 to diagnose Mute Master Clips — that bug is fixed, so the extra log lines are gone
